rationale: A's hero assembles with a clear stagger (masked headline, CTAs, speaker, then price) and is complete by ~1.3 s, and its scroll story (exploded four-part view, stats, light materials section, specs) stays clean through to the footer. B has more ambitious art direction (exploded parts, frequency-response chart, giant 'Halo' footer), but a preloader holds the screen for over 2 s and at 3 s and even 'after entrance' the hero shows only a lone 'H' under a curtain arc; the mobile first viewport is still the loader. B's custom-cursor difference-blend hover turns buttons into garish blue/orange blobs, whereas A's hovers (underlines, glow, ring highlight) are restrained and clear.
